notes: Every file referencing the exported LimitCheck interface. Rule: adding a required field to an interface breaks exactly the files that name the type — the service that constructs it and the UI/hooks that consume it. Files that call checkLimit() and immediately read one property off the result without naming the type are out. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts (ts-morph over corpus/taskflow/tsconfig.json); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. tests/** is excluded from every key: the tasks ask about application code, and a spec that merely exercises a symbol is not a place the behaviour lives.
